messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: ingress-euc2 high 5xx error rate detected on ALB target group (avg 12% over 2m). Alert rule: ingress.5xx.rate > 5%

samir.k: on it. jumping into metrics and ALB -> target health now.

lia: I can grab traffic routing if you want me to start weighted DNS shift.

samir.k: yes pls. first confirm whether this is ALB-level or downstream Envoy/ingress controller.

raj: ALB shows surge of 502/504 from targets in euc2b. Target health toggling between healthy/unhealthy. backend logs show large `connection reset by peer` spikes.

carla: rolling `kubectl logs -n ingress -l app=ingress-controller --tail=200` now to check envoy errors.

samir.k: running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $TG_EUC2` -> many targets reported Unhealthy (502). attaching sample: `TargetHealth: {State: unhealthy, Reason: target-response-code}`

carla: envoy log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] upstream reset: connection failure: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
[2026-03-15T14:12:04Z] 5xx from upstream: codec error, stream error
```

paul: is this across AZs in the region or isolated to a single AZ?

raj: looks concentrated in euc2b. euc2a and euc2c healthy. ALB cross-zone enabled though; traffic from euc2b nodes seems to be dropping connections.

samir.k: suspect NIC flapping or host-level kernel conntrack exhaustion in euc2b. running `ssh` to a problematic node to check dmesg and conntrack counts.

carla: `kubectl top nodes` shows no CPU/memory pressure. dmesg on node shows repeated network device resets: `mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: XDP: PF reset`

lia: OK — hardware NIC hits. mitigation plan: 1) remove euc2b targets from ALB target-group to stop routing new connections, 2) shift small percent of DNS weight to euc1 region as safety, 3) scale up ingress pods in other AZs if needed.

samir.k: doing step 1 now: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn $TG_EUC2 --targets Id=i-0abc...` (progress: 6/18 targets deregistered).

incident-bot: NOTE: Automatic failover policy triggered? No. Manual action required.

raj: after removing unhealthy targets, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 40s. post-change graphs: https://grafana.redwood/ingress/euc2/5xx?panel=rate

cecilia: Customer-support heads up: SCC queue shows 4 active escalations referencing long page loads for hosted API customers in EU. I'm prepping a short status to send.

paul: lia, can you do a 5% DNS weight shift to euc1 for the next 10min while we validate? We need to avoid full region failover.

lia: doing DNS move via route53 traffic policy. `change-id` submitted. TTL reduced to 20s for safe rollback.

carla: there's a patch in kernel logs indicating firmware offload errors for Mellanox NICs. I'll open a ticket with infra/host-providers but for now nodes need reboot which requires rolling drain.

samir.k: propose short-term mitigations: keep euc2b targets out of ALB, continue small DNS diversion, schedule rolling reboot of euc2b hosts with controlled draining; also add a temporary envoy-level retry-to-next upstream policy to absorb more transient resets.

raj: confirmed: retries reduced user-visible 5xx by ~40% for api endpoints tested. We have to be careful with retries and head-of-line latency but ok as temporary.

lia: DNS shift completed, ~6% traffic now going to euc1. graphs show overall 5xx below 1.5% across endpoints.

cecilia: Sent customers: "We're aware of intermittent 5xx errors affecting some EU traffic. We've mitigated by removing problematic hosts and shifting a small share of traffic; more updates in 30 minutes."

samir.k: creating incident record and assigning to oncall-handoff at 15:40Z. We need to track host firmware/kernel patch with infra.

paul: next steps: infra to validate NIC firmware and coordinate provider patch windows; platform to add automated detection for repeated device resets per host; product to assess any SLA credit exposure.

carla: starting rolling reboot of euc2b nodes now, using `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` and `reboot`. Will bring back nodes one at a time and re-register to ALB only after healthchecks pass.

lia: I will take this to the next shift (handoff) — adding summary + checklist in ops-docs and tagging `sre-oncall-next`.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03015-EUC2-ALB-NIC. Severity: Sev2. Handoff: lia (next oncall).

samir.k: thanks all. staying on until nodes healthy. will update incident timeline.

lia: taking over monitoring. please post any follow-up notes into this thread for postmortem. :thumbsup:
